subject: astronomy
title: Space Exploration: Robotic Missions
welcome_lead: Robots go where humans can't — and they keep sending postcards.
meta_desc: KS3 astronomy: rovers, probes, space telescopes.
final_note: Most of what we know about other planets came from robots.

concepts.def: Robot spacecraft sent to study space.
Robot that drives on another world.
Two probes that flew past the outer planets.
A planned trip with a goal.

walkthroughs.body_html: Launched in 1977, the Voyager probes have left our solar system. They carry golden records with sounds from Earth in case anyone finds them.
NASA's Curiosity and Perseverance rovers drive across Mars taking pictures, drilling rocks and looking for signs of ancient life.
The James Webb Space Telescope sees infrared light from baby galaxies. Hubble looks at visible light. Both orbit far above Earth's atmosphere.
